recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If future changes are needed to questionnaire-referenceProfile itself, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack and coordinate with SDC guidance rather than adding a core Questionnaire element.
issue_request: FHIR-13934 asked to move the allowedProfile extension into core Questionnaire as Questionnaire.item.profile for items whose type is reference. The final Published/Not Persuasive with Modification decision declined a new core element and instead directed implementers to SDC guidance and extension documentation.
initial_application: The linked Zulip discussion reached the same compromise: profile limiting can be useful, but the existing extension plus clearer documentation is the right path. Core commits ca66dbfb4340eb7d6e6a6f0f425ca9f7d70cbe65 and 15a7574205a04b50cba39ccf84e8b5b214ed3bc6 applied that path by adding SDC links to Questionnaire-specific and Questionnaire-relevant extension definitions.
additional_context: Questionnaire remains an active core resource, but the old Questionnaire extension definition files are no longer active core profile inputs. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed those extension definitions from the R5 source, and the current FHIR Extension Pack source contains questionnaire-referenceProfile with the relevant contexts, canonical StructureDefinition value, and SDC guidance link. Current core Questionnaire prose already points to SDC and notes SDC extensions for min, max, type.targetProfile, constraint, and definition-based processing.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding Questionnaire.item.profile would contradict the final Jira decision, and reintroducing or editing questionnaire-referenceProfile in core would duplicate an artifact now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. The current core and Extension Pack sources already convey the intended implementation path.

related_jiras.note: A separate already-published audit on the combined branch for Questionnaire dynamic option extensions cites FHIR-13934 as background for SDC-guidance and external-extension handling. It was not re-decided here.
